excerpt: Learning Outcomes: On successful completion of this module students should be able to: 1. Demonstrate an understanding of data and information produced and consumed in day to day life employing visual means. 2. Demonstrate an understanding of data visualisation and related theories and principles. 3. Demonstrate knowledge of basic data analysis and manipulation skills. 4. Employ basic tools and technique for data visualisation and information design. 5. Develop a data-driven visual story.
